core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nujum is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Stars”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nujum corresponds to the Arabic form نُجُوم (Arabic root ن ج م (n-j-m); نُجُوم (Nujūm)). Its core sense is stars. Nujum is Arabic نُجُوم (Nujūm) 'stars', the plural of نَجْم (najm), from the root ن ج م (n-j-m). The source gloss 'Stars' is consistent. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled the gender unisex; the form is a common noun with no personal-name gender.

persian.name: نجوم
